_comment: Reviewed floor for the Rasuwa-Bhotekoshi flood. Deaths currently NDRRMA / MoHA, 1 Ashwin 19:00 (364+232+222+203+199+78+72+38+2 Kathmandu in treatment = 1410). Uncontacted about 6,145 — the board heads it that way; published parts (Rasuwa local 1,393 + Rasuwa other 1,286 + Nuwakot local 651 + Nuwakot other 1,136 + foreign 587) are exclusive labels and must not be added into a false closing sum; handed-over remains (110) are a cut label; holding-district labels (1,743 across 27 centres: Nuwakot 832 · Rasuwa 817 · Dhading 94) are separate. Injured 344 hospitalised across 19 hospitals: NDRRMA also publishes security-force field treatment 9,820 as a label — not a flood-injury total. Deployed 21,022 / NDRRMA rescued graphic 13,756. The ten-minute cycle reads nirajbhusal.github.io/rasuwa-flood-bulletin and merge_sitrep replaces a group only when its parts add up; a failed scrape leaves these numbers standing. Deaths never go down — Nepal Police (1,367 dead / 4,077 missing on the bulletin's police panel) is a separate running count, and a lagging compilation must not put 1,388 back over NDRRMA 1410. The overview also shows live government figures beside this grid (BIPAD corridor incidents, NDRRMA rescued-persons totals, OPMCM portal counters); those come straight from the portals and are never merged into these numbers. Two rules govern edits. (1) Never sum across groups that the source keeps apart - the `exclusive` flags and `do_not_merge` notes exist because several of these counts overlap, and adding them would invent casualties. (2) Every breakdown must sum to its own stated total; app/domains/flood/merge.py re-adds them at load and the page shows a warning if either stops reconciling. Do not add Tibet or India's dead onto Nepal's 1410. Uncontacted (NDRRMA toll) is not the OPMCM family missing-person report count — those are separate filings and must never be added together.

notes.body_en: Kathmandu DEOC still lists 88 injured brought to valley hospitals as a separate collection from the official 314. Kathmandu District Police said on 31 August that 33 of 48 patients at the National Trauma Centre had been discharged and 15 remained in care. Rasuwa Hospital Dhunche reports 74, of whom 49 were discharged and 24 referred. Police assistance desks are at Bir Hospital and the Trauma Centre. These hospital counts are not added to the 314.
notes.body_ne: काठमाडौं डीईओसीले उपत्यकाका अस्पतालमा ल्याइएका ८८ घाइतेलाई आधिकारिक ३१४ भन्दा छुट्टै संकलनका रूपमा राखेको छ। काठमाडौं जिल्ला प्रहरीले ३१ अगस्टमा राष्ट्रिय ट्रमा सेन्टरका ४८ मध्ये ३३ डिस्चार्ज र १५ उपचाररत रहेको बताएको छ। रसुवा अस्पताल धुन्चेमा ७४ मध्ये ४९ डिस्चार्ज र २४ रेफर। प्रहरी सहयोग डेस्क वीर अस्पताल र ट्रमा सेन्टरमा छन्। यी अस्पताल गणना ३१४ मा जोडिँदैनन्।

notes.title_en: Rs 1 billion from the PM fund, to be sent
notes.body_en: The Prime Minister's Disaster Relief Fund operating committee decided on 16 Bhadra to send Rs 1 billion immediately to flood-affected areas. That is a disbursement from the fund, not extra cash on top of the Rs 8.46 billion already in the banks. Source: Office of the Prime Minister on nepal.gov.np.
notes.body_ne: प्रधानमन्त्री दैवी प्रकोप उद्धार कोष सञ्चालन समितिले १६ भदौमा बाढी प्रभावित क्षेत्रमा एक अर्ब तत्काल पठाउने निर्णय गरेको छ। यो कोषबाट बाहिरिने रकम हो, बैंकमा रहेको ८ अर्ब ४६ करोडमाथि थप होइन। स्रोत: प्रधानमन्त्री कार्यालय, nepal.gov.np।

notes.body_en: The monsoon response command at the Ministry of Home Affairs decided on 16 Bhadra to send Rs 6.75 crore to 15 palikas in Rasuwa, Nuwakot, Dhading, Gorkha and Tanahun. NDRRMA's 19 Bhadra update also cites Rs 13.5 crore allocated to 15 heavily affected palikas — that later line is carried on the relief-received panel and is not added onto this 6.75 crore. Neither is cash inside the MoF bank table. Source: MoHA on nepal.gov.np; Prasashan citing NDRRMA 19 Bhadra.
notes.body_ne: गृह मन्त्रालयको मनसुन प्रतिकार्य कमाण्डले १६ भदौमा रसुवा, नुवाकोट, धादिङ, गोरखा र तनहुँका १५ पालिकालाई ६ करोड ७५ लाख पठाउने निर्णय गरेको छ। एनडीआरआरएमएको १९ भदौ अपडेटले अति प्रभावित १५ पालिकालाई १३ करोड ५० लाख विनियोजन पनि भनेको छ — त्यो पछिल्लो रेखा राहत-प्राप्त प्यानलमा छ र यो ६.७५ करोडमाथि जोडिँदैन। दुवै MoF बैंक तालिकाको नगद होइनन्। स्रोत: गृह, nepal.gov.np; प्रशासन (एनडीआरआरएमए १९ भदौ)।

name_lists.do_not_merge_en: Eight lists, published separately by different offices. The same person can appear on more than one, so they are never added into a single rescue total. The official injured figure stays 314. NDRRMA's graphic of 13,095 rescued is a separate count from these named lists.
name_lists.do_not_merge_ne: आठ सूची, फरक-फरक कार्यालयले छुट्टै प्रकाशित गरेका। एउटै व्यक्ति एकभन्दा बढी सूचीमा पर्न सक्छ, त्यसैले यी एउटै उद्धार जम्मामा जोडिँदैनन्। आधिकारिक घाइते संख्या ३१४ नै रहन्छ। एनडीआरआरएमएको उद्धार ग्राफिक १३,०९५ यी नामावलीभन्दा छुट्टै गणना हो।
